kai: FYI during harbor-v3 q4f16 onboarding I’m seeing strange sampling behavior for CJK + mixed RTL prompts. Greedy/beam is fine; stochastic sampling inserts spaces inside CJK grapheme clusters and flips parentheses direction in arabic+en mixes. BLEU drops ~1.3 for zh->en. Anyone observed q4f16-specific sampling instability? :thinking:
hera: can you paste a minimal repro, run args and summary stats?
kai: short run (staging, quant=q4f16, sampler=top-p=0.9,temp=0.8, n=100):
```
# locale stats
en mean_entropy=3.05 token_split_rate=0.012
zh mean_entropy=4.9 token_split_rate=0.078 kl_vs_en=1.7
ar mean_entropy=4.25 token_split_rate=0.054 kl_vs_en=1.2
# example zh src: "\u8bf7\u9009\u62e9\u60a8\u7684\u5e10\u53f7\u3002"
sample: "\u8bf7 \u9009 \u62e9 \u60a8 \u7684 \u5e10 \u53f7\u3002"
# mixed ar+en src: "\u0627\u0644\u0623\u0633\u0645 (user123) \u0625\u0630\u0627"
sample: "\u0627\u0644\u0623\u0633\u0645 )user123( \u0625\u0630\u0627"
```
hera: big gap between greedy and sampling suggests logits tail noise. Did you compare logits between float and q4f16?
kai: I dumped logits for a problematic prefix and saw many CJK subtokens within 1e-41e range in q4f16; float baseline shows clearer softmax margin. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/harbor-q4f16-logits (private).
matt: a few suspects: 1) tokenization/detok path divergence under sampling, 2) quantized kernel numeric jitter (softmax/fused-attention), 3) KV-cache precision differences. Any recent runtime changes?
suki: infra note: "fast-softmax-q4f16" and "fast-detok-bytepath" were rolled to staging last week (deploy ids rel-2026-03-22 and rel-2026-03-21).
qa-bot: automated check: sampling_entropy_delta(zh) = +1.85 vs float baseline; token_split_rate_delta(zh) = +0.066 -> FAIL gating rule.
kai: I re-ran with `--detok=utf8-normalize` and split_rate dropped to 0.035 (closer but not baseline). Lowering temp to 0.6 helps a bit (split_rate ~0.04) but still above float baseline. Greedy remains fine.
hera: let's run a small isolation matrix: (runtime fused/unfused softmax) x (weights float/q4f16) x (detok fast/utf). That should tell whether kernel math or tokenizer path is main cause. I'll queue jobs with n=64 per locale to keep quick.
matt: also add a short bisect over commits touching fused-softmax and detok path in the last two weeks. If we see a step-change in entropy/split_rate, we have a kernel/regression.
suki: CI: queued a matrix run ci-7352 (harbor-q4f16-sampling-matrix). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/ci-7352 :rocket:
kai: temporary onboarding mitigation: set recommended sampler for harbor-v3 q4f16 to top-k=40,temp=0.6 for CJK locales and add note in onboarding checklist. Also adding a unit check: token_split_rate_delta <= 0.04 and sampling_entropy_delta <= 0.9 vs float baseline.
hera: agreed. If matrix implicates fused-softmax, we should consider a hotfix revert for q4f16 runtime and fallback to unfused kernel while we fix numeric stability.
matt: I'll prepare bisect script and collect per-step logits/rank-deltas for the ruby/parenthesis spans. If it's tokenizer-related, the detok-normalize fix should show improvement.
qa-bot: ticket created ML-1723 with examples, logs, and CI run id ci-7352. Assigned: @hera (matrix + bisect), @matt (log analysis), @suki (release flags).
kai: thanks all. I'll drop the small prompt set into /datasets/onboard/harbor/locale-spot.json and update ticket with the reproducible command used. Will check back in ~3h. :thumbsup:
